description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.059 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Full dividend intelligence for any US stock: trailing 12-month yield, forward annual rate, payout frequency (monthly/quarterly/semi-annual/annual), 5-year dividend CAGR, consecutive years paid, consecutive years of growth, and complete 5-year dividend history with dates and amounts. Single call — no API key. Ideal for income screening, dividend safety analysis, and yield comparison across a portfolio.

ticker.description: US stock ticker (e.g. AAPL, JNJ, KO, T, SCHD). Case-insensitive.

name: dividend-intel

cagr_5yr_pct.description: 5-year compound annual growth rate of total annual dividends. Null if < 2 years of data.

consecutive_years_growth.description: Number of consecutive years with annual dividend growth (most recent streak).

consecutive_years_paid.description: Number of consecutive years with at least one dividend payment (up to 5-year history).

forward_annual_rate.description: Estimated annual dividend based on most recent declared amount × frequency.

history.description: Dividend payments, most recent first (up to 5 years).

pays_dividend.description: False if no dividends found in 5-year history.

trailing_yield_pct.description: Trailing 12-month dividend yield as a percentage of current price.
